title: Art. 9.10.3 — Annex 14 - Aerodromes, Volume I - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Chapter 9 - Aerodrome Operational Services, Equipment and Installations, 9.10 Fencing, Application, 9.10.3
content: Suitable means of protection shall be provided to deter the inadvertent or premeditated access of unauthorized persons into ground installations and facilities essential for the safety of civil aviation located off the aerodrome.
